test_ivf_search_preassigned: test GpuIndexIVFFlat, GpuIndexIVFPQ, and GpuIndexIVFScalarQuantizer with preassigned coarse quantizer search results
test_ivf_pluggable_coarse_quantizer: test GPU IVF indices using a CPU-trained coarse quantizer shared between CPU and GPU indexes
test_interleaved_ivfpq_layout: test GpuIndexIVFPQ with interleaved layout enabled and verify copyTo and copyFrom between GPU and CPU
test_ivf_indices_32_64_bit: test GpuIndexIVFFlat, GpuIndexIVFPQ, and GpuIndexIVFScalarQuantizer with 64-bit and 32-bit index storage options
test_gpu_autotune_parameter_space: test GpuParameterSpace to initialize, list, and set parameters like quantizer_efSearch on a GPU index
